lines: -   `Tabs`: Show an outline only on the keyboard-focused tab in forced colors mode, not on a hovered tab. In both orientations, use the design system focus color, which keeps its contrast in the dark theme, and the design system corner radius ([#86913](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86913)).

-   `ResizableBox`: When the box or an ancestor is rotated or scaled, keep the dragged handle under the pointer, turn the resize cursor with the handle and keep the handles the same size on screen ([#86884](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86884)).
-   `TabPanel`: Show the selection indicator as a solid line in forced colors mode at every pixel density ([#87347](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87347)).

+-   `Panel`: Keep `PanelHeader` 48px tall, including its bottom border, inside containers that apply the `reset` mixin, such as the editor sidebar ([#87333](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87333)).
+	// A last header has no bottom border, so it is one pixel shorter.
-	// This helps ensure the correct panel height, including the border, avoiding subpixel rounding issues.
+	// Include the bottom border in the height. The `reset` mixin sets
+	// `box-sizing` on descendants with the same specificity, so a content-box
+	// height would lose a pixel inside containers that apply it.
-   Save widget areas in sequence so overlapping requests cannot move widgets to Inactive Widgets ([#87445](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87445)).
+-   Sidebar: Make the tab bar 48px tall, like the inserter's, with the selected tab's indicator over its bottom border ([#87333](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87333)).
+// Overlap the header's bottom border, so the selected tab's indicator
+// covers it, as in the inserter.
-   `DocumentOutline`: Show the post title when the editor canvas is iframed or the template is shown, and focus it on click ([#87280](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87280)).

-   `PluginMoreMenuItem`, `PluginSidebarMoreMenuItem`: Make SVG icons without their own fill follow the text color again, so they no longer stay black on a highlighted item ([#87399](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87399)).

-   `ErrorBoundary`: Make "Copy contents" on the crash screen copy the post content, including unsaved changes, instead of an empty string ([#87421](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87421)).
+-   Sidebar: Make the tab bar 48px tall, like the inserter's, with the selected tab's indicator over its bottom border ([#87333](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87333)).
